description: Free. Before connecting an MCP server, get its signed Annalist check: grade, uptime over 7 days, connect time, sign-in mode, tool count, whether its tools changed recently (the 'rug pull' pattern) and reasons. By registry name (io.github.user/server) or URL. Verify the signature with the key at /.well-known/annalist-key.json.

name.description: Official MCP Registry name, for example io.github.user/server
